item.title: The AI Writes the Screenplay, the Renderer Never Lies
item.description: Generative video is a slot machine: same prompt, different pixels every run. vsim flips the design. The AI writes a validated screenplay document, and a deterministic pure TypeScript renderer turns it into the same MP4, byte for byte, on any machine, forever.
